title: Witnessed finite-coefficient compactification origins
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A, retain an etale-origin witness consisting of an actual intrinsic pro-etale derived object K, a bounded-below etale antecedent L, and its canonical comparison isomorphism. Give these witnesses the induced category containing every ambient map. Construct the comparison/realization functor origin, its exactness instances, and the canonical fixed open and compact-support coordinate identifications. For each compactification refinement construct intrinsicRefinement from the proper compositor, inverse proper/open comparison, and retained witness; require natural, identity, composition and common-refinement coherence, determining the pairwise comparison uniquely. At a recorded finite coefficient stage its refinement component equals the specified refinementComparisonIsomorphism conjugated by the fixed coordinate identifications. Define finite Frobenius direct exchange using the ambient mate. Pull back the retained antecedent, preserve its lower bound, and use the pulled witness to transport the compact exchange between compactifications. All existing names, hypotheses and construction formulas are retained from def-weil-operation-exchange-coefficient-descent; no new comparison is selected. For compactification coherence and refinement normalization, choose a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, an integer n at least 1, and a field K_0 with ell invertible. Specialize A to the positive finite coefficient ring O_E/(varpi_E^n) and use a separated finite-type K_0 map between finite-type K_0 schemes. Geometry for finite Frobenius exchange is the existing finite-field datum. Pullback statements retain the original scheme maps and actual Cartesian-square and witnessed-domain hypotheses, without adding geometric linearity or Frobenius invertibility assumptions. The Lean attachment contains the exact coherence statement and all 34 original declarations.

source.place: Witnessed-domain comparison, refinement normalization, common refinements and the cocycle; the finite-origin coordinate section of def-weil-operation-exchange-coefficient-descent. Finite Frobenius formulas retain the original direct/compact operation definitions.

proof.text: Construct the comparison and exact-derived open/direct-image coordinate changes by the recorded ordinary units and compositors. The retained witness is transported through the same canonical realization unit. This defines precisely originUnderlying, origin, the CompactOrigin category, fixedCompactModel, fixedOriginWitness, fixedRefinementOpen and intrinsicRefinement with their existing formulas.

Reuse compactification_coherence in its fixed-scalar witnessed coordinates. For an intrinsic origin (K,L,alpha), apply inverse intrinsic realization to K and then finite-coefficient realization; use fixedOriginWitness and the exact-derived composition isomorphism to retain precisely L and its comparison. Boundedness is transported along this explicit isomorphism. On every ambient map use these same realization functors, giving recordedOriginFunctor. The finite-realization unit identifies its underlying fixed object with the inverse intrinsic realization. Whisker this identification with fixedCompactModel and the intrinsic realization counit to obtain a natural candidate comparison. Naturality of the finite-realization unit identifies the recorded witness with fixedOriginWitness followed by that unit. Naturality of the proper compositor and conjugate_refinement then cancel the units, identifying the transported canonical refinement with intrinsicRefinement. Transport theta and the common-refinement comparisons from compactification_coherence through these natural candidate isomorphisms. Functoriality and cancellation give the identity and composition laws, and the existing finite-family clause is unchanged. Finally any two pairwise comparisons agree by their formulas at a common refinement of the pair, proving the required uniqueness.

For the intrinsic pairwise cocycle, choose a common refinement of three compactifications from intrinsicCompactificationCoherence, substitute its three normalized comparison formulas, and cancel the middle isomorphism and its inverse. Exact etale inverse image preserves the lower bound by Functor.isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj.

For intrinsicCompactificationComparison_refinement, use the common-refinement formula with the identity at c to identify the pairwise comparison with intrinsicRefinement. For the transported origin the retained witness is the original witness followed by the realization unit; this is unit naturality after cancelling the exact-composition isomorphism. Functoriality of the proper-open witness formula and naturality of the proper compositor identify the fixed refinement as conjugation by that unit. Naturality of the fixedCompactModel isomorphisms and the two triangle identities cancel the outer counits and the conjugating units, yielding exactly the specified refinementComparisonIsomorphism.

For the finite-field datum, instantiate the ambient exchange at the actual Frobenius Cartesian square. Pull back the retained etale antecedent by exact inverse image, transport its actual comparison, and use Functor.isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj to keep its lower bound. Define transportCompact as pullback of the pairwise compactification comparison, the fixed compactification exchange, and the inverse pairwise comparison at the pulled witness.

lean.statement:
theorem intrinsicCompactificationCoherence :
    let A := Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E n hn
    ∃ theta : ∀ (c d : Compactification f) (_r : c ⟶ d),
        intrinsicOriginCandidate A c ≅ intrinsicOriginCandidate A d,
      (∀ (c d : Compactification f) (r : c ⟶ d) (O : CompactOriginCategory A X),
        (theta c d r).app O = intrinsicRefinement A r O) ∧
      (∀ c, theta c c (𝟙 c) = Iso.refl _) ∧
      (∀ (c d e : Compactification f) (r : c ⟶ d) (s : d ⟶ e),
        theta c e (r ≫ s) = theta c d r ≪≫ theta d e s) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin m → Compactification f),
        ∃ d : Compactification f, ∀ i : Fin m, Nonempty (d ⟶ c i)) ∧
      ∃! comparison : ∀ c d : Compactification f,
          intrinsicOriginCandidate A c ≅ intrinsicOriginCandidate A d,
        ∀ (c d b : Compactification f) (r : b ⟶ c) (s : b ⟶ d),
          comparison c d = (theta b c r).symm ≪≫ theta b d s
